About OrbitCare

OrbitCare is a space-mission wellbeing monitoring platform designed to organise physical health readings and daily mental wellbeing check-ins for astronauts.

The platform provides health reading comparisons, wellbeing indicators, trend visualisations and reports.

🚀 Astronaut Health Quest

A focused action dashboard. Each item below connects an issue identified in your submitted data with a relevant, practical support action. It does not use step counts or exercise targets.

🏅 Mission Progress & Achievements

Earn points by reviewing your issue-specific support actions and recording a safe follow-up. Points reward engagement—not whether a health concern has disappeared.
